lines.say: My client stopped coming in. So I chased his car. On foot.
caps: So I chased his car. *On foot.*

lines.say: Four miles. Then I stole a monster truck, and kept going.
Then I hijacked a helicopter. The pilot was a very nice man. He just kept saying, sir, please.
Comment KEEP if you've ever chased down a client who ghosted you.
caps: down a client who ghosted you.

lines.say: Then the cops joined in. Eleven cars. Then the news. Then, somehow, a parade.
caps: Then the cops joined in. Eleven cars.

lines.say: He finally pulled over. Rolled down the window. Looked at me, and said, bro. You could've just texted me.
He was just busy. That's it. Four miles, a monster truck, a helicopter, and nobody sent one text.
So now I use Message Health. It spots who's gone quiet, and texts them before they forget.
lines.show: So now I use MsgHealth. It spots who's gone quiet, and texts them before they forget.

lines.say: No chase. No helicopter. No parade. Just a text.
caps: No chase. No helicopter. No parade.
